en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a grand 19th-century building along a broad tree-lined boulevard in a well-developed town. The image is titled 'Sundsvall, Esplanaden.' There is handwritten Swedish text on the front. The reverse side has a Swedish 5 öre stamp canceled in 1906, with more handwritten text and pre-printed multilingual 'Postkarte' instructions. The address is to Herr Fabrikör Wald. Kassman, Stockholm, at Hotel Germania.
